items.titleZh: 诺里斯获胜，梅赛德斯以顽强表现锁定车队冠军
items.summaryZh: 诺里斯在巴西大奖赛中战胜雨势，为麦克拉伦赢得了三个月以来的首胜，尽管梅赛德斯今年首次没有获得领奖台。
items.originalTitle: Norris wins as Mercedes clinches title with a scrappy race
detailZh: 诺里斯 在巴西大奖赛中战胜雨势，为麦克拉伦赢得了三个月以来的首胜，尽管梅赛德斯今年首次没有获得领奖台。
诺里斯在起跑后几乎立即失去了领先，因为基米·安东内利的梅赛德斯在1号弯道前加速超过了他，随后利安·劳森的小红牛车队迅速将诺里斯降至第三。
诺里斯很快从劳森手中夺回了第二名，但安东内利在车队等待从中间胎切换到干胎的最佳时机时，沿着赛道逃脱了领先。
麦克拉伦和诺里斯做出了正确的决定，因为他在安东内利之前一圈进站，缩小了很大的差距。
安东内利在第二圈时努力让他的软胎加速，结果在1号弯道处打滑，让诺里斯获得了比赛领先。
安东内利的滑行还在继续，红牛车队、伊萨克·哈德贾和马克斯·维斯塔潘纷纷超越了他。
他报告说他的车在自行转向，尤其是在左转弯时特别困难。
诺里斯此后无人能威胁，他在前方建立了如此坚实的差距，即使是晚来的雨和换回中间胎也没有动摇他对领先位置的掌控。
这标志着诺里斯和麦克拉伦车队自8月底在赞德福特以来的首次胜利。
领奖台由维斯塔潘和哈德贾组成，其中维斯塔潘从第21位发车，在最初的几圈中追加了10个位置。
乔治·拉塞尔最终在9月巴库以来首次击败了安东内利，尽管他在从中间胎换成干胎后，在维修区打转。
他通过只在干胎上跑了一节就找回了一些失去的时间，而大多数其他车手在晚些时候切换回中间胎之前需要两套轮胎。
拉塞尔尽管在奔驰车上也报告了平衡问题，但还是成功超越了安东内利。安东内利后来因为不安全的维修区释放时间被罚，但这并没有改变他的结果。
第四和第五名对于梅赛德斯来说已经足够，他们可以在剩余三场比赛之前锁定车队冠军——这是他们自2021年以来的第一个车队冠军，因为法拉利遭遇了一场棘手的比赛。
像维斯塔潘一样，刘易斯·汉密尔顿在第一圈发起了猛烈的冲刺，从第20位上升到了第9位，但他在使用中间胎时遇到了麻烦，甚至被费尔南多·阿隆索的阿斯顿·马丁本田车队超越。
汉密尔顿是第一个切换到干胎的车手，并在那里重新夺回了位置，但在比赛结束时需要再次进维修区更换中间胎之前，他因为打滑而损失了时间。
他在旗杆处排名第九，而队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔在赛道上排名第七，但在与劳森发生碰撞后，因被罚5秒而降至第八位，排在小红牛车队之后。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在第六位结束比赛，比他的麦凯轮车队队友诺里斯慢了56.4秒。
尽管尼科·胡肯伯格在第一弯道与弗朗哥·科拉平托的阿尔皮纳赛车发生碰撞，不得不在赛道上服10秒罚时，但他仍为奥迪赢得了最后一名积分，排名第十。

detailEn: Lando Norris survived a late downpour to take McLaren’s first race win in three months at the Brazilian Grand Prix, as Mercedes sealed the Formula 1 constructors’ title despite its first podium-less GP of the year.
Norris lost the race lead almost immediately off the line as Kimi Antonelli’s Mercedes rocketed past him on the run to Turn 1, with Liam Lawson’s Racing Bulls then quickly demoting Norris to third.
Norris soon wrestled second back from Lawson, but Antonelli escaped down the road in the lead as the field waited for the right moment to switch from intermediate to slick tyres.
McLaren and Norris got that call right as he pitted a lap before Antonelli and closed a lot of that gap.
Antonelli struggled to fire up his soft tyres and ended up spinning at Turn 1 on his second lap, allowing Norris into the race lead.
Antonelli’s slide continued as the Red Bulls, Isack Hadjar and Max Verstappen, picked him off.
He reported his car was steering by itself, and he was struggling to get around the left-hand corners in particular.
Norris went unthreatened thereafter, building such a solid gap out front that even a late-rain shower and switch back to intermediates didn’t do anything to unsettle his grip on the lead.
It marks Norris and McLaren’s first victory since Zandvoort in late August.
The podium was completed by Verstappen and Hadjar, the former of whom charged from 21st on the grid, making 10 of those positions up in the first couple of laps.
George Russell ended up beating Antonelli for the first time since Baku in September, despite spinning in the pitlane after changing from intermediates to slick tyres.
He regained some of the lost time by doing just one stint on slicks while most other drivers needed two sets before the late switch back to intermediates.
Russell then passed Antonelli despite also reporting balance issues aboard his Mercedes. A later unsafe pit release time penalty for Antonelli made no difference to his result.
Fourth and fifth is enough for Mercedes to clinch the constructors’ title - its first since 2021 - with three races to spare, as Ferrari suffered a tricky race.

Like Verstappen, Lewis Hamilton made a spirited opening lap charge, going from 20th to ninth, but he fell back as he struggled on his intermediates, even being passed by Fernando Alonso’s Aston Martin Honda.
Hamilton was the first to switch to slick tyres and regained positions there, but he lost time to a spin just before he needed to pit for intermediates again at the end of the race.
That left him ninth at the chequered flag, while team-mate Charles Leclerc was seventh on the road before a 5s penalty for a clash with Lawson meant he dropped to eighth behind the Racing Bulls.
Oscar Piastri finished 56.4s behind McLaren team-mate Norris in sixth place.
Nico Hulkenberg took the final point for Audi in 10th place despite having to serve a 10-second time penalty for going off the track at Turn 1 while fighting with Franco Colapinto’s Alpine.

items.originalTitle: F1 Brazilian GP: Lando Norris wins in mixed conditions, Mercedes clinch constructors’ title
detailZh: F1巴西大奖赛：诺里斯在复杂天气中获胜，梅赛德斯夺得车队 constructors’冠军
诺里斯在受雨影响的巴西大奖赛中为迈凯轮赢得了本赛季的第三次胜利，同时梅赛德斯车队获得了世界 constructors’冠军
诺里斯在混合天气的2026年F1巴西大奖赛中赢得了他的第三次胜利，击败了卷土重来的马克斯·维斯塔潘，同时梅赛德斯车队夺得了世界 constructors’锦标赛
在早期从世界冠军继任者基米·安东内利手中夺回领先位置后，由于他打滑，杆位车手诺里斯阻止了维斯塔潘在一场从开始到结束都在湿滑条件下进行的比赛中最新的惊人巴西反击，这场赛事以一段干燥的天气作为结尾
在到达起跑线时的惊险一幕中，安东内利在复杂的第12弯道滑向草地，但他成功超越了杆位车手诺里斯，在第一弯道取得了领先，而比赛在中间轮胎条件下开始。第三位发车的利亚姆·劳森也跟随梅赛德斯车队进入了第二位。
阿隆索是最大的输家，他在第3弯道失误，排名下降了六位。刘易斯·汉密尔顿则相反，他上升了10位，进入了第11位，而维斯塔潘在两位车手因引擎处罚从最后一排发车后，跳到了第13位。
随着安东内利在劳森和诺里斯之间建立了5秒的差距，汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘很快找到了彼此，但汉密尔顿在磨损的后胎上开始挣扎。这位七届世界冠军无法在奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂之前超越维斯塔潘进入前十，反而被阿斯顿·马丁的阿隆索超过了。
汉密尔顿敦促车队为他更换干胎，最终在第71圈的15圈时实现了愿望，成为第一个做出更换的车手。他在干燥天气轮胎上的即时速度触发了一轮全场的进站，整个车手阵容都换上了软胎，安东内利和维斯塔潘比其他领跑者多等了一圈。
兰多·诺里斯，麦克拉伦，利亚姆·劳森，小红牛，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
在那次混乱之后，安东内利从诺里斯、伊萨克·哈德贾尔和回归英雄维斯塔潘手中保持了领先，维斯塔潘和劳森都设法超过了哈德贾尔。然而，拉塞尔却在维修区出口处打滑，幸运地没有造成损坏，但落后于皮亚斯特里和奥迪的尼科·胡肯伯格。
安东内利在诺里斯的压力下越来越难以控制，他报告说车辆的悬挂出现问题，导致车辆向一侧倾斜。这一点在第一圈中戏剧性地表现出来，他在那里打滑出赛道，诺里斯趁机获得了领先，但他能够重新加入比赛。
安东内利的操控问题继续，红牛车队的哈德贾尔和维斯塔潘轻松地超越了他们，进入了领奖台的位置，哈德贾尔在第38圈超过了维斯塔潘。
在落后哈吉尔五秒之后，安东内利成功稳定了第四名的位置，与皮亚斯蒂、劳森、拉塞尔和胡肯博格之间保持了一个健康的差距，而两位法拉利车手从车队中间的位置出发，并没有取得太多进步。
从最后一位发车，维斯塔潘在比赛过半后突然来到了第二位，与领跑者诺里斯相差九秒。维斯塔潘在第四十六圈时进行了第二次进站，更换了一组软胎，而哈吉尔则信心满满地希望在不需要再次进站的情况下完成比赛。
在比赛还剩23圈时，细雨开始落在赛道上，麦克拉伦为诺里斯进行了第二次进站，更换软胎。作为回应，哈吉尔在第五十一圈时放弃了单站策略，进站维修，这使得安东内利领跑，而梅赛德斯则决定赌一把更大的雨或安全车。但随着新科世界冠军每圈损失超过一秒，梅赛德斯很快在第五十四圈时进站更换了新的干胎。
随着策略再次趋同，诺里斯继续与维斯塔潘周旋，他成功捍卫了七秒的差距，而哈吉尔在第三位落后了八秒。
但是，在第62圈时天空再次开始下雨，这触发了一次大规模的转向中间轮胎的移动，诺里斯和维斯塔潘都在第63圈进站，而汉密尔顿在进站前在光滑的赛道上打滑幸存。
诺里斯冷静地控制着危险的最后几圈，赢得了他本赛季的第三次胜利，而维斯塔潘以14秒的差距排在第二位，哈德杰以9秒的差距排在第三位。
拉塞尔以第四名的成绩领先安东内利，两辆赛车都克服了晚期的平衡问题，帮助梅赛德斯赢得了它的第九个车队 constructors' championship，这是自2021年以来的第一个这样的奖杯。
皮亚斯蒂为迈凯轮获得了第六名，领先勒克莱尔和勇敢的劳森，劳森继续为他在小红牛的F1未来而战斗，但在最后几圈未能保持领先于勒克莱尔。
像勒克莱尔一样，汉密尔顿也无法维持真正的反击，最终排名第九，尽管库尔特加斯因为离开赛道并获得优势而受到10秒的处罚，但仍获得了最后一名的积分。
拉斐尔·卡马拉在取代埃斯蒂安·奥康的首次亮相中排名第20，最后一名，而兰斯·斯特罗尔在本赛季第14次退赛，发生在阿斯顿·马丁车队。瓦尔特里·博塔斯因右后轮螺母交叉螺纹而未能发车，他的凯迪拉克赛车出现了问题。
detailEn: F1 Brazilian GP: Lando Norris wins in mixed conditions, Mercedes clinch constructors’ title
Lando Norris hands McLaren its third victory of the Formula 1 campaign in a rain-affected Brazilian Grand Prix, as Mercedes seals the world constructors' title
Lando Norris has snared his third win of 2026 in a mixed weather Formula 1 Brazilian Grand Prix, defeating a resurgent Max Verstappen while Mercedes claimed the world constructors' championship.

After reclaiming the lead from his world champion successor Kimi Antonelli early on when he spun off, polesitter Norris thwarted Verstappen's latest stunning Brazil comeback in a race which both started and finished in the wet, bookending a dry spell.

Having survived a scare on the laps to the grid when he slid onto the grass at the tricky Turn 12, Antonelli picked off polesitter Norris for the lead into Turn 1 as the race started in intermediate conditions. Third-place starter Liam Lawson also followed the Mercedes through into second.

Alonso was the biggest loser as he dropped six places by going wide at Turn 3. Lewis Hamilton went the opposite direction, gaining 10 places to sweep into 11th, while Verstappen jumped to 13th after both drivers had started at the back of the grid with engine penalties.

As Antonelli built a five-second buffer to Lawson and Norris, Hamilton and Verstappen soon found each other, with Hamilton starting to struggle on worn rear tyres. The seven-time world champion couldn't follow Verstappen past Oscar Piastri and into the top 10, the Ferrari being passed by Aston Martin's Alonso instead.

Hamilton urged his team to bring him in for slicks and eventually got his wish on lap 15 of 71, being the first driver to make the switch. His immediate speed on the dry weather tyre triggered a flurry of pitstops across the grid as the entire field switched to softs as well, Antonelli and Verstappen waiting one lap longer than the other frontrunners.
Lando Norris, McLaren, Liam Lawson, Racing Bulls, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

After that shuffle, Antonelli kept the lead from Norris, Isack Hadjar and comeback hero Verstappen, who both made their way past Lawson. Russell, however, lost out by spinning in the pit exit, being fortunate enough to escape damage but dropping behind Piastri and Audi's Nico Hulkenberg.

Antonelli came under increasing pressure from Norris, reporting a problem with the suspension that made his car pull to one side. That became apparent in dramatic fashion as he spun off the track in Turn 1, releasing Norris into the lead but being able to rejoin.
Antonelli's handling woes continued as Red Bull duo Hadjar and Verstappen easily worked their way past into the podium positions, with Hadjar waving Verstappen by on lap 38.

After dropping five seconds behind Hadjar, Antonelli was able to stabilise things in fourth with a healthy buffer to Piastri, Lawson, Russell and Hulkenberg, while neither Ferrari driver was able to make much progress from the middle of the pack.

From starting at the rear, Verstappen suddenly found himself in second place just after halfway, with a nine second deficit to race leader Norris. Verstappen pulled the trigger on a second pitstop on lap 46 for a new set of softs, while Hadjar was bullish on making it to the end without stopping again.

As a light drizzle hit the track with 23 laps to go, McLaren pressed ahead with a second pitstop to softs for Norris. Hadjar abandoned the one-stop plan with a pitstop on lap 51 in response, leaving Antonelli in the lead as Mercedes decided to gamble on heavier rain or a safety car. But with the newly crowned world champion losing over a second per lap, Mercedes soon abandoned that plan with a lap 54 pitstop for new slicks.
As strategies converged again, Norris continued matching whatever Verstappen could throw at him as he defended a seven-second gap, with Hadjar another eight seconds in arrears in third.

But the heavens started opening again on lap 62, which triggered a mass move to intermediates within the space of two laps, Norris and Verstappen both peeling in on lap 63 as Hamilton survived a spin on slicks right before pitting.

Unperturbed, Norris coolly controlled the treacherous final laps to snare his third win of the campaign, with Verstappen settling for second 14 seconds behind the McLaren driver, while Hadjar third another nine seconds behind.
Russell was fourth ahead of Antonelli, both cars overcoming late balance woes to earn Mercedes its ninth constructors' championship, its first such trophy since 2021.
Piastri was sixth for McLaren ahead of Leclerc and a valiant Lawson, who continues fighting for his F1 future with Racing Bulls but was unable to keep Leclerc behind in the closing laps.

Like Leclerc, Hamilton was unable to sustain a genuine comeback as he settled for ninth, with Hulkenberg taking the final point in 10th despite a 10-secondpenalty for leaving the track and gaining an advantage.

Rafael Camara finished 20th and last on his home debut as Esteban Ocon's replacement, as Lance Stroll retired for the 14th time this season in the Aston Martin. Valtteri Bottas did not make the start due to a cross-threaded right-rear wheel nut on his Cadillac.

items.summaryEn: Mercedes secured the 2026 Formula 1 constructors' championship at the Brazilian Grand Prix at Interlagos, the team's ninth constructors' title. Kimi Antonelli and George Russell started second and seventh, with Russell having taken a five-place grid penalty.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯在巴西大奖赛加冕2026赛季F1车队总冠军
梅赛德斯在巴西大奖赛上锁定其第九次F1车队总冠军
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发与比赛分析。
梅赛德斯赢得了2026年一级方程式锦标赛的车队总冠军，在英特拉格斯举行的巴西大奖赛上锁定了这一头衔。
基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔分别从第二位和第七位发车，此前这位英国车手被罚退后五位发车。虽然安东内利在比赛起步时从杆位得主兰多·诺里斯手中夺得领先，并在前七圈将优势扩大到五秒，但他在第20圈的第一弯打滑，给了诺里斯重新夺回位置的机会。
在比赛最后几圈的大雨后，拉塞尔和安东内利分别以第四和第五名完赛，这足以让车队领先于法拉利，后者的车手夏尔·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿分别获得第七和第九名。
“我们锁定了总冠军。我认为这是最重要的事情。感谢你们挺了过来！”梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫在方格旗挥动后通过无线电对拉塞尔说道。
这位英国人回应道：“干得好，各位。很高兴看到我们今年取得的成就。”
兰多·诺里斯赢得了巴西大奖赛，迈凯伦车手与红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔一同登上领奖台。
梅赛德斯抵达圣保罗时领先法拉利126分，需要带着129分的领先优势离开。
这个冠军为车队完成了年度双冠，一周前安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛上锁定车手总冠军，成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。
2026年的总冠军是这支位于布拉克利的车队第九次获得制造商冠军，此前他们已在2014、2015、2016、2017、2018、2019、2020和2021年夺冠。
沃尔夫随后与印地赛车系列赛前车手、F1 TV评论员詹姆斯·欣奇克利夫讨论了这一成就。
“首先，英特拉格斯和圣保罗的每一个人，这真是一场盛宴。感谢你们的款待。太棒了，”他说。
“赛季开局非常强劲，这让我们冲过了终点线，但最近几场比赛有时也颇具挑战。今天很艰难，但总体而言，我为这个组织感到无比自豪。
“我们花了几年时间才重返榜首。没有多少车队能够从那样的处境中恢复过来，这恰恰说明了我们组织内部的出色工作和优秀人才，能成为他们中的一员真是太棒了。”
detailEn: Mercedes crowned 2026 F1 constructors' champion at Brazilian GP
Mercedes secured its ninth Formula 1 constructors' championship at the Brazilian Grand Prix
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes has won the 2026 Formula 1 constructors' championship, sealing the title at the Brazilian Grand Prix at Interlagos.

Kimi Antonelli and George Russell started second and seventh on the grid, after the Briton took a five-place grid penalty. While Antonelli took the lead from polesitter Lando Norris at the start of the race and extended his advantage to five seconds over the first seven laps, he later spun into Turn 1 on lap 20, giving Norris the opportunity to retake the position.

After heavy rainfall in the closing laps of the race, Russell and Antonelli finished fourth and fifth, which was enough to put the team out of reach of Ferrari, whose drivers Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton finished seventh and ninth, respectively.
"We secured the championship. I think this is the most important [thing]. Thank you for surviving!" Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff told Russell over the radio after the chequered flag.
The Briton responded: "Well done, everybody. It's great to see what we have achieved this year."
Lando Norris won the Brazilian Grand Prix, and the McLaren driver was joined on the podium by Red Bull's Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar.
Mercedes arrived in São Paulo 126 points clear of Ferrari and needed to leave with a lead of 129 points.
The title completes a championship double for the team, one week after Antonelli clinched the drivers' crown at the Mexican Grand Prix to become the youngest world champion in the history of F1.
The 2026 title is the Brackley outfit's ninth constructors' championship, after already winning in 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2021.
Wolff later discussed the achievement with former IndyCar Series driver and F1 TV pundit James Hinchcliffe.
"First of all, everybody here at Interlagos and in São Paulo, it has been a real blast. Thank you for having us. It's amazing," he said.

"It was a very strong beginning of the season and that got us over the line, but also these last few races have been challenging at times. Today, it was difficult, but overall, I'm so proud of the organisation.

"We've taken a few years to be back on the top spot. Not many teams have been able to come back from such a situation, and it just shows the great work, the great people that we have in our organisation, and it's fantastic to be among them."

查尔斯·勒克莱尔在迎接他的第一个孩子后的几天，戴着一块价值125,000美元的理查德·米勒手表抵达巴西大奖赛
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
法拉利一级方程式车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔在巴西大奖赛之前抵达Interlagos，手腕上戴着一块六位数的手表。
根据名人手表追踪账号Watches of Celebrities的报道，这位摩纳哥车手在抵达维修区时佩戴了一款理查德·米勒RM 33-02碳纤维TPT和玫瑰金款手表。该账号估计其市场价为125,000美元。
RM 33-02在发布时限量140件，当时报道的售价为145,000美元。
该设计偏离了瑞士品牌典型的独特外观。理查德·米勒最出名的是其桶形表壳，但RM 33-02采用由多层碳纤维制成的圆形表壳，并配备铂金摆轮。
勒克莱尔是理查德·米勒的代言人，多年来一直被看到佩戴该品牌的许多手表，包括他自己的RM 67-02 勒克莱尔。
“自从他在卡丁车时代的早期，我就一直密切关注查尔斯的进步，”米勒谈到法拉利车手时说。
“以他的成绩和快速的预选赛而闻名，这位车手吸引了我的注意和热情，立即说服了品牌支持他初露头角的天赋。”
勒克莱尔在妻子亚历山德拉在比赛周末前几天生下他们的第一个孩子比安卡后，比以往晚些时候到达圣保罗。
“对我来说，这是一周非常、非常特别的日子，”他在周六预选赛结束后对媒体说。“这可能是我一生中最好的几周之一，显然。有职业生活，也有家庭生活。在那个时刻，家庭生活才是唯一重要的事情。而这周对我来说是极其特别的。”
当被问及是否在赛道上集中注意力很困难时，勒克莱尔补充道："作为一名车手，当你关闭风挡时，你会有种重置的感觉。在我的生活中，我曾有过其他一些非常困难的时刻。而这次，事情完全相反，一切都非常不可思议。"
"但在我的私人生活中，无论是这两种极端情况，我认为一旦你关闭风挡，你就会非常专注于唯一的一件事。"
detailEn: Charles Leclerc turns heads with $125,000 watch at F1 Brazilian GP
Charles Leclerc arrived at the Brazilian Grand Prix wearing a Richard Mille watch valued at $125,000, days after welcoming his first child
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Ferrari Formula 1 driver Charles Leclerc arrived at Interlagos ahead of the Brazilian Grand Prix wearing a six-figure watch on his wrist.

According to watch-spotting account Watches of Celebrities, the Monegasque driver wore a Richard Mille RM 33-02 in Carbon TPT and rose gold when he arrived at the paddock. The account puts its market price at $125,000.
The RM 33-02 was limited to 140 pieces when it launched and was reported to cost $145,000 at the time.

The design strays from the distinctive look typical of the Swiss brand. Richard Mille is best known for its barrel-shaped cases, but the RM 33-02 has a round case made from layers of carbon fibre and features a platinum rotor.
Leclerc is a Richard Mille ambassador and has been seen wearing plenty of the brand's watches over the years, including his own RM 67-02 Charles Leclerc.
"Since his early days in karting, I have closely followed Charles’ progress," Mille said of the Ferrari driver.
"Noted for his times, and his speedy qualifiers, the driver attracted my attention and enthusiasm, immediately convincing the brand to support his budding talent."
Leclerc arrived in São Paulo later than usual after his wife, Alexandra, gave birth to their first child, Bianca, a few days before the race weekend.

"It's been a very, very special week for me," he told the media after qualifying on Saturday. "Probably one of the best weeks of my life, obviously. There's the professional life, and there's also the life that is at home. And the life at home in those moments is the only thing that matters. And this week was incredibly special."

When asked if it was difficult to concentrate on track, Leclerc added: "When you close the visor as a driver, you kind of reset. I've had other moments where in my life things were very difficult. And this time it's on the other side of the spectrum where things are incredible.
"But in both those extremes in my private life, I think once you close the visor, you are really very much focused on one thing and one thing only."

detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫希望FIA取消初级员工的薪资上限：“我们需要给他们更好的报酬”
托托·沃尔夫透露，他已向FIA提议在预算帽中为初级员工薪资设立豁免额度以提高其待遇，但该提议被拒绝
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
F1预算帽确实做到了它该做的事：它拉近了车队之间的差距，并阻止了大型工厂车队单纯靠砸钱来解决问题。但尽管赛道上的竞争无疑更胶着了，幕后的财务压力正开始对人造成影响。
在2026年巴西大奖赛第三次自由练习赛的转播中，天空体育F1评论员娜奥米·希夫提到了威廉姆斯车队负责人詹姆斯·沃尔斯提出的一个有趣观点。沃尔斯认为，成本上限正迫使各车队将部件使用到极其接近其绝对里程极限的程度——这完美解释了为什么当前发车区充斥着引擎罚单，马克斯·维斯塔潘、乔治·拉塞尔以及两辆法拉利都在英特拉格斯遭遇了发车位处罚。
托托·沃尔夫不仅表示赞同，还揭开了布拉克利财务现实变得多么残酷的帷幕。
“是的，绝对如此。我的意思是，我们知道成本上限为何出现，”沃尔夫向天空体育团队解释道。“但我们正处于如此边缘的境地，多一些会更好，你知道。就我们而言，我们无法将所有底盘留到明年。有些需要被切碎。
“当你看看这些赛车的纪录时，这相当令人难过，”沃尔夫补充道。“所以每支车队都承受着压力。情况都一样。”
虽然切割碳纤维很痛苦，但沃尔夫对成本上限最大的不满在于，它直接压制了真正制造赛车的男女员工的薪水。
F1 严重依赖才华横溢的年轻工程毕业生，他们为车队付出大量时间。但在现行预算规则下，工厂工资受到限制。沃尔夫透露，梅赛德斯曾积极游说国际汽联解决这一问题。
“我本希望能有一点上浮空间，”沃尔夫表示。“我认为我们，尤其是我们当时的想法，是让更多加入车队的初级人员获得更多额度来提高他们的薪酬。而不是让他们的薪资在头五、六、七年里被压制。”
这位梅赛德斯老板想向管理机构明确表示：这并非偷偷寻找漏洞以获取更多空气动力学研发的企图。他只是想为初级员工支付公平的市场价格，以匹配他们为锦标赛投入的疯狂工时。
“所以我们已经向国际汽联提出这个请求，希望给我们一项额度，不是为了提高前翼，而是为了给薪资留出稍微上调的空间，”他说，“因为预算上限把这一切都压制住了。”
毫不意外，要求国际汽联放宽财务规则并没有得到好的回应。沃尔夫承认，这个提议基本上从一开始就注定失败。
“但显然，这并没有赢得多少好感分，”沃尔夫以一贯的冷峻现实口吻总结道。
目前，布拉克利以及围场其他车队的年轻工程师们，只能继续在当前财务上限下埋头苦干，而车队负责人则继续把每一个赛车部件压榨到极限。
detailEn: Toto Wolff wants the FIA to lift the salary cap on junior staff: “We need to pay them better”
Toto Wolff reveals he pitched the FIA for a cost cap allowance to boost junior staff salaries, but the proposal was rejected
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

The Formula 1 cost cap did exactly what it was supposed to do: it brought the grid closer together and stopped the massive factory teams from simply outspending their problems. But while the on-track product is undeniably tighter, the financial squeeze behind the scenes is starting to take a human toll.

During the Free Practice 3 broadcast at the 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix, Sky Sports F1 pundit Naomi Schiff brought up an interesting point raised by Williams boss James Vowles. Vowles suggested the cost cap is forcing teams to run parts uncomfortably close to their absolute mileage limits - which perfectly explains why the grid is currently drowning in engine penalties, with Max Verstappen, George Russell, and both Ferraris all taking grid drops at Interlagos.
Toto Wolff didn't just agree; he peeled back the curtain on how brutal the financial reality has become at Brackley.

"Yeah, absolutely. I mean, we know why the cost cap happened," Wolff explained to the Sky Sports crew. "But we are so on the edge of things that would be better to have more, you know. In our case, we're not able to carry all chassis over to next year. Some need to be chopped up.
"Which is quite sad when you look at the record of these cars," Wolff added. "So every team is under pressure. It's the same."
While chopping up carbon fibre is painful, Wolff’s biggest grievance with the cost cap is how it directly suppresses the pay cheques of the men and women actually building the cars.

F1 relies heavily on brilliant, young engineering graduates who grind out massive hours for the team. But under the current budget regulations, factory wages are being restricted. Wolff revealed that Mercedes actively lobbied the FIA to fix this exact issue.

"I would have loved to have a little bit of an uplift," Wolff stated. "I think that we, especially the idea that we had was for more junior personnel that joined the team, that we would have more allowance to pay them better. And not being the salaries suppressed in the first five, six, seven years."

The Mercedes boss wanted to make it crystal clear to the governing body: this wasn't a sneaky attempt to find a loophole for more aerodynamic development. He just wanted to pay the junior staff a fair market rate for the insane hours they put into the championship.
"So we've pitched that to the FIA to give us an allowance, not for more front wing, but an allowance for salaries to come up a little bit," he said. "Because the cost cap suppresses all of that."
Unsurprisingly, asking the FIA to open up the financial rulebook didn't go over well. Wolff admitted the pitch was essentially dead on arrival.
"But obviously, that didn't score a lot of brownie points," Wolff concluded with a dose of dry reality.

For now, the young engineers at Brackley - and across the rest of the grid - will have to keep grinding under the current financial ceiling, while team bosses continue to stretch every single car component to its breaking point.

detailEn: Gabriel Bortoleto's partner Isabella Bernardini shows off custom Audi dress at Brazil GP
Gabriel Bortoleto's partner Isabella Bernardini turned heads at the Brazilian Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Gabriel Bortoleto's partner Isabella Bernardini arrived at Interlagos ahead of the Brazilian Grand Prix in a one-off dress made from Audi's special adidas range for the race.

The dress was made by designer and upcycler Fiona Roerig, who worked with the team and Bernardini to incorporate their ideas into the design. The dress has been upcycled from the adidas Sampa Soul collection, which the German outfit launched for Bortoleto's home race.
The colours come straight from that range, with forest green set against metallic gold, while the embroidery draws on São Paulo's history of crochet and needlework.
Bernardini also included references to Bortoleto by incorporating his race number, five, into the design.

Fans have been quick to share their thoughts on the unique design. "Beautiful merchandising by Isabella! And there couldn't be a better number one supporter and fan for our Brazilian boy!" one commented on X, while another added: "Ahh I love it!! She looks gorgeous. We need merch like this!!"
"A team where everyone gets treated equally. Impressive," someone else posted, while another comment read: "That dress is gorgeous."
Bortoleto will start his home grand prix from 19th on the grid after sliding into the barriers during a rain-soaked qualifying session.
"Early in the qualifying, I was trying to keep some distance from Ollie [Bearman], as I was catching up to him," Bortoleto told the media after qualifying.

"I ended up locking the front wheel and couldn’t stop the car in time before hitting the wall. It wasn’t a hard impact, but it shifted the wing, and we couldn’t continue like that. They tried to replace it, but there wasn’t enough time.

"At the start of qualifying, it was very wet. Coming out of turns 4 and 5, you couldn’t go full throttle. Honestly, at the corner where I crashed, it was very easy to lock a wheel and end up in the wall."

He added: "For now, I just want to go home and rest; it’s been a very long day. Everything had been going incredibly well until I made a mistake in qualifying. I need to clear my head, and tomorrow we’ll figure out the plan. I’ll likely be starting from the back, or close to it. I just want to try and put together a strong recovery race."

items.summaryEn: Hamilton and Verstappen will start the Brazilian Grand Prix 20th and 21st on the grid, meaning both begin from the back of the field and Sunday's race promises to be fascinating.
detailZh: “我会想办法争取赢”——汉密尔顿与维斯塔潘能否在F1巴西大奖赛上反击夺冠？
这两位传奇车手将从圣保罗站队尾发车，且对自身机会并不太乐观
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利；马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘在巴西大奖赛分别以第20和第21位发车，无论天气条件如何，周日的F1正赛都注定引人关注。
汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘恰好是两位在若泽·卡洛斯·帕塞赛道（Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace）上演过令人难忘的逆转好戏的车手，而这条赛道上的超车历来比大多数赛道都更容易。
2021年，这位七届世界冠军因技术违规被取消排位赛成绩，这意味着他在冲刺赛中从最后一位起步；他一路拼杀追至第五。由于更换新引擎被罚退五位发车，汉密尔顿在正赛中从第十位起步，但一路奋战至前列，并在与维斯塔潘的史诗级对决中笑到最后。
三年后，这位荷兰车手在一个湿漉漉的周日早晨于第二节排位赛（Q2）被淘汰，还因使用第六台内燃机被罚退五位发车，最终在发车格上位列第十七。雨水同样影响了正赛，但维斯塔潘迎难而上，轻松超越埃斯特班·奥康夺得胜利。
但当年助力汉密尔顿完成那些非凡超车的，是DRS装置；而如今一级方程式新动力单元上配备的超车模式（overtake mode）并没有那么具有决定性；英特拉格斯赛道的布局甚至可能让情况更糟。
当被问及与2021年相比超车会有多容易时，这位法拉利车手回答说：“更难了，因为当时我们显然有一条非常长的直道，如果你跟得够近，你就有DRS，而也许前车没有——而现在，每个人都能打开自己的尾翼。
“我认为超车会非常、非常、非常困难。我不确定你们会看到和过去一样的比赛。但也许湿滑的条件会改变这一点。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利；马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
“现在我们不再有DRS了，”维斯塔潘表示同意。“而且这里的超车模式因为长直道而非常受限，每个人都在耗尽电池。所以，你在直道上的速度差会小得多——真的有点像墨西哥。因此，超车会比平时困难得多。”
那么汉密尔顿的策略会是什么？“我没有策略，”他回答道。“想办法赢下来。”
与此同时，维斯塔潘如果要成为胜利的争夺者，他把希望寄托在多次事故上。“很多安全车，这样他们就无法拉开差距，机会就会不断回到我这边，”这位红牛车手说道。“我们走着瞧。我不会想太多。我就从第一圈开始跑，看看最终能到哪儿。”
他补充道：“我希望（和刘易斯一起）我们能尽快清掉前面的车。”
在2026年F1迄今的19场大奖赛中，只有两场比赛是由头排以外的车手赢得的。维斯塔潘在墨西哥从第五位发车取胜，尽管他在第一圈就实际上取得了领先；安东内利则在意大利从第19位发车惊人夺冠。但如果预期的降雨影响比赛，那么2026年干地条件下的历史将毫无意义。
补充报道：Isa Fernandes 与 Federico Faturos。
detailEn: ‘I’ll try to win, somehow’ – Can Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen fight back for F1 Brazilian GP victory?
The two legends will start the Sao Paulo race from the back of the grid – and aren’t too optimistic about their chances
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
With Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen 20th and 21st on the grid of the Brazilian Grand Prix, Sunday’s Formula 1 race promises to be fascinating – regardless of weather conditions.
Hamilton and Verstappen happen to be two drivers who performed memorable recoveries at Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace, a track where overtaking has always been easier than most.

Back in 2021, the seven-time world champion was excluded from qualifying results due to a technical breach, meaning he started the sprint from last; he fought his way up to fifth. With a five-place grid drop for a new engine, Hamilton was 10th on the grid for the grand prix but battled to the front and came out on top in a titanic duel against Verstappen.

Three years later, the Dutchman was eliminated in Q2 on a wet Sunday morning and also took a five-place grid penalty for his sixth internal combustion engine, ending up 17th on the grid. The rain also impacted the race, but Verstappen rose to the occasion and comfortably overtook Esteban Ocon for victory.

But the DRS device had facilitated Hamilton’s exceptional drives, and the overtake mode that now features on F1’s new power units instead isn’t as decisive; the Interlagos layout might actually make it worse.

When asked how easy overtaking would be compared to 2021, the Ferrari driver replied: “Harder, because back then we had, obviously, a very long straight, and if you got close, you had the DRS, and maybe a car wouldn't have it – whereas now, everyone is just opening up their wings.
“I think overtaking will be very, very, very hard. I'm not sure you're going to see the same sort of races that you've seen in the past. But maybe the wet conditions will change that.”
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing

“Now we don't have DRS anymore,” Verstappen concurred. “And the overtake mode is very limiting around here because of the long straight, everyone is draining the battery. So, your speed difference on the straight is going to be a lot less – a bit like Mexico, really. So, it will be quite a lot harder to pass than normal.”
So what will Hamilton’s strategy be? “I don't have one,” he responded. “Try to win, somehow.”

Verstappen, meanwhile, is banking on a number of incidents if he is to be a contender for victory. “Lots of safety cars, so they can't pull away, it keeps coming back to me,” the Red Bull racer said. “We'll see. I don't really think about it too much. I'll just go from lap one and see where I end up.”
He added: “I hope [with Lewis] we can clear the cars in front of us as quickly as we can.”

Across 19 grands prix so far in F1 2026, just two races have been won from outside the front row. Verstappen prevailed from fifth on the grid in Mexico, though he was virtually in the lead on lap one, and Antonelli remarkably triumphed from 19th in Italy. But if the expected rain impacts the race, then 2026’s dry-weather history will be meaningless.
Additional reporting by Isa Fernandes and Federico Faturos

detailZh: 迈凯伦的2027规格前翼让F1赛车更可预测
在英特拉格斯，迈凯伦引入了明年赛车上将早期使用的这一前翼概念——它让当前赛车更易于驾驶
迈凯伦领队安德烈亚·斯特拉表示，在F1巴西大奖赛为MCL40引入的2027规格前翼概念改善了赛车的驾驶性和可预测性。
这支总部位于沃金的车队在英特拉格斯推出了升级包——不仅包括这款前翼，还包括后翼、梁翼和新的底板部件——此前迈凯伦在过去几个月里在与梅赛德斯、法拉利和红牛的竞争中落后。
兰多·诺里斯在若泽·卡洛斯·帕塞赛道夺得杆位，队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里仅列第12位，但大雨意味着这并不能代表升级套件的实际影响。不过，各节练习与排位是在干燥赛道上进行的，因此得以更深入地了解新部件。
“通常，我们带到赛道的升级不会影响赛车的驾驶性，它们只是为了增加下压力，”斯特拉说。“但这次，我要说，尤其是前翼，我们同时也开始着手解决赛车需要更易于驾驶、而不仅仅是增加下压力的问题。
“我们相对满意，因为前翼的表现符合预期。根据车手的反馈和我们测量的数据，我们看到这似乎让驾驶性稍微容易了一些。
“从赛车驾驶性稍有改善，到拥有一辆真正易于驾驶的赛车，之间仍有很大的差距；我们正在为明年的赛车研究这一点。令人鼓舞的是，我们带来的升级——它们是明年赛车的前身——已经按预期发挥了作用。”
预计两周后的下一场大奖赛会有更多升级：“拉斯维加斯会有一些新部件，”斯特拉宣布。
“所有部件在某种程度上都需要相互配合，而我们在拉斯维加斯增加的这些部件显然会适应前翼所产生的气流。但就提升驾驶性和赛车可预测性而言，前翼才是主要部件。
“所以我们会再增加一些气动效率，但我不预期赛车行为会有显著变化；要做到那一点，我们需要更多地着眼于明年。”
就周日的圣保罗正赛而言，斯特拉不确定杆位得主诺里斯能否守住优势。这位意大利人在排位赛壮举后确实称自己的车手为‘雨战大师’，但也承认拉塞尔在Q3可能本质上更快——而如果条件最终转为干地，那不会对迈凯伦有利。
“如果在干燥条件下，根据练习赛来看，梅赛德斯似乎领先一步，”他说。“[基米] 安东内利在练习赛中非常快。对拉塞尔来说很难说，因为他起步非常快，然后轮胎性能下降了。但尽管我们对赛车做了改进，目前我们还没有条件说我们是以最好的正赛节奏进入比赛的。”
detailEn: McLaren’s 2027-spec front wing is making its F1 car more predictable
At Interlagos, McLaren introduced the front wing concept it will use early on with next year’s challenger – and it is making the current car easier to drive
McLaren team principal Andrea Stella says the 2027-spec front wing concept introduced on the MCL40 at Formula 1’s Brazilian Grand Prix has improved the car’s driveability and predictability.

The Woking-based outfit launched an upgrade package at Interlagos - featuring not just this front wing but also a rear wing, a beam wing and new floor furniture - after McLaren lost ground to Mercedes, Ferrari and Red Bull in the last couple of months.

Lando Norris took pole at Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace, with team-mate Oscar Piastri down in 12th, but heavy rain meant this wasn’t representative of the updates’ impact. The practice sessions, however, took place on a dry track, allowing for a deeper understanding of the new parts.

“Normally, the upgrades that we have taken trackside did not affect the driveability of the car, they were just aimed at increasing the load,” Stella said. “But in this case, let me say that especially for the front wing, we were also aiming to start addressing the fact that the car needs to be just more drivable, not only more loaded.

“We are relatively happy that the wing behaves as expected. Based on the comments of the drivers and the data that we measure, we see that this seems to have made the driveability a little bit easier.

“Between the driveability of the car being a bit easier and having an easy car to drive, there's still quite a lot to bridge; we are looking at that for next year's car. And it's encouraging that the upgrades that we are bringing – they are precursor to what will be next year's car – have worked as expected.”
Further updates are expected at the next grand prix in two weeks’ time: “There will be some new parts in Vegas,” Stella announced.

“All the components kind of want to talk to each other, and these additional components that we have in Vegas will obviously be adapted to the flow generated by the front wing. But the front wing, in terms of improving the driveability, the predictability of the car, was the major component.
“So we are going to add some more aerodynamic efficiency, but I don't expect a significant change in the behaviour of the car; to have that, we need to look more into next year.”

As far as Sunday’s Sao Paulo race is concerned, Stella is unsure whether polesitter Norris can hold on to his advantage. The Italian did describe his driver as a ‘rainmaster’ following his qualifying feat, but admitted that Russell probably was intrinsically quicker in Q3 – and if conditions turned out to be dry after all, that wouldn’t favour McLaren.

“If it was in dry conditions, based on practice, Mercedes seemed to be a step ahead,” he said. “[Kimi] Antonelli was very quick in practice. Difficult to say for Russell because he started his run very fast and then he degraded. But despite the improvements we have made to the car, at the moment we are not yet in condition to say that we entered the race with the best race pace.”

items.originalTitle: The wet-weather challenges thrown up by Brazilian GP qualifying
detailZh: 巴西大奖赛排位赛的雨天挑战
圣保罗的天气一开始温暖，但很快因为降雨而变得几乎无法进行，让车手们面临了他们职业生涯中最湿滑的赛道条件之一
一小时二十三分钟。你几乎可以把一场足球比赛的大部分时间都压缩在圣保罗大奖赛F1排位赛的雨中延误里，而且看起来这个环节实际上不会再开始了
2024年的情况似乎会重演，当时排位赛被压缩到了周日早上，但就在这时，一个救星出现了，云层出现了一丝缝隙，赛道干燥到足够安全车专家Bernd Maylander批准赛道的条件。这几乎无法阻止一些车手抱怨能见度，但他们很快接受了他们需要锁定并专注于绕赛道行驶
这意味着使用较少见的全湿胎，或者按照F1术语的"x-wet"。这种轮胎常常被嘲笑为只适合在安全车后面笨拙地行驶，但实际上这种蓝色侧壁的Pirelli轮胎表现相当不错，并且证明非常适合赛道周围的水位。尽管如此，由于轮胎难以打破赛道上的水膜，水漂现象仍然普遍——但随着雨势减弱，水分的分散很快使赛道恢复到可驾驶的状态。
使用极端湿胎的缺点在于水分分散得更快（据Pirelli称，每秒约85升水），这极大地降低了能见度，因为车后喷出的水花像公鸡尾巴一样。然而，水分分散是必要的恶行：没有它，赛道会保持更长时间的水湿状态。
尽管雨灯确保了后面的车手至少有一定程度的能见度，但选择刹车区域仍然很棘手；能见度低意味着车手必须在他们的视野范围内找到一个参考点。停车距离也相应地更长，因此车手需要不同于干燥路面上的刹车踏板应用点。
考虑到所有这些气候挑战，难怪赛车控制对湿滑条件采取更为谨慎的态度。因此，看到赛会重新开放练习是个令人惊喜的消息——即使赛道仍然因为下午的暴雨而泥泞不堪。卡洛斯·塞恩斯认为这是FIA的一个"大胆"决定——但只用了几圈就确保了车辆更加稳定。
“当我们从x-wet轮胎起步时，感觉有点打滑，因为我们在直线道上第六和第七挡时都在水漂。如果你在那个速度下失去对车辆的控制，那肯定是一次很大的失误，”赛恩斯在赛后总结道。
“此外，当你紧贴着其他车辆行驶时，能见度非常低，但在排位赛中我们没有被迫紧贴其他车辆，所以可以留出一定的空间来观察。但两圈下来，情况非常不稳定。”
“然后我们设法找到了那一点干燥的路面，轮胎开始正常工作，水漂现象也开始消失。每个人都设法将车辆保持在赛道上直到Q1结束，这实际上有点令人惊讶。”
“利亚姆·劳森同意赛恩斯的看法，他表示，“当我们开始比赛时，情况非常不稳定——我认为我们确实是在冒险。但我喜欢我们出现在赛道上而不是在维修区；显然这是有风险的，但事故并不多。”
正如预期的那样，湿滑的天气条件给了那些通常不习惯在顶级位置战斗的赛车机会；自由练习中的性能追逐实际上变得无关紧要，动力单元之间的差距略微缩小，因为顶级性能和加速的效果被低抓地力的赛道条件所减弱。
这使低速下压力变得更加重要，更重要的是，在Q1期间保持轮胎温暖——尽管费尔南多·阿隆索还是指出，“发动机在驾驶性和它在弯道中的表现方面非常重要，我们在这方面仍然有一些问题。”
通过Q1的策略最初只是尝试跑出干净的圈速，并希望赛道的进展和轮胎的进步能够带来圈速的逐圈提升。
当然，每位车手都在发生水漂时测试了他们的反应时间，2026年的动力单元和对后刹车的控制增加了另一个需要克服的障碍。但每位车手（在很大程度上）都越来越专注于调整，看着圈速提高，然后随着赛道变干，开始稍微加大刹车区域的压力。
Q2阶段有一个转折点，因为中雨胎很快成为了最佳选择。由于积水减少，全雨胎开始过热，并且在赛道中段损失性能，最初足以抵消第一和最后两个赛段的潮湿，但在三个赛段都更适合使用中雨胎之前，这种情况就已经发生了。
这意味着他们可以更多地追求赛道抓地力，并且很明显，在Q2结束时，随着赛道在暴雨中达到最佳状态，时间开始达到峰值。劳森认为他和他的小红牛车队已经完美掌握了中雨胎的时机，这是在不冒掉出赛道风险的情况下获得更快圈速的关键。
一些车手在这个转换点上遇到了困难，尤其是在12号弯的收获和刹车时——塞恩斯和Ollie 贝尔曼都在这里出了事故，而新来的Rafael Camara在Q2结束时无法让车足够慢下来，撞上了护栏。
在Q3期间预计会有更多雨，所以更多的是一场疯狂的冲刺，以完成一个干净的圈速，而不是观察进展。这可能就是感觉最像'正常'的排位赛的时候，因为轮胎实际上足够支持一整圈的预期暴雨设置了一个计时器。
大多数车手真正地享受了这种罕见的机会，去应对真正的湿滑赛道，尽管有些人对恢复练习有所顾虑。乔治·拉塞尔推测说：“我喜欢在雨中驾驶——但如果是比赛，我们不应该那样驾驶——发生真正可怕事故的可能性非常高。”
年轻车手和年长车手之间可能存在一些意见分歧；刘易斯·汉密尔顿和尼科·胡肯伯格都表达了对湿滑赛道的喜爱，而新冠军基米·安东内利则称这是“我开过最湿滑的条件”；他和贝尔曼都说在Q1恢复时赛道已经超出了极限，尽管后者承认早期的练习至少有助于赛道改善。
无论如何，这对每位车手在周日比赛前的数据都是宝贵的——届时恶劣天气预计将再次发挥作用。因此，夜间讨论开始了：是否有人为了设置改变而冒险从维修区起步？

detailEn: The wet-weather challenges thrown up by Brazilian GP qualifying
A warm start to the day in Sao Paulo quickly descended into a near-washout as the rain fell - and left drivers facing some of the wettest conditions they've driven in across their racing careers

One hour, 23 minutes. You could've squeezed most of a football match into the rain delay during Formula 1 qualifying for the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, and it looked for all the world like the session wouldn't actually get going again.

A repeat of 2024, where qualifying was squeezed onto Sunday morning, looked likely. Yet, a saviour arrived when a break in the clouds emerged, and the circuit had dried just enough for safety car specialist Bernd Maylander to give his approval of the conditions. It scarcely stopped a handful of drivers from having a moan about the visibility, but they soon accepted that they needed to lock in and focus up on getting around the track.

This meant the use of the lesser-spotted full-wet tyre, or the "x-wet" per the F1 lexicon. Often derided as a tyre only fit for bumbling around on behind the safety car, the blue-walled Pirelli was actually holding up pretty well and proved perfect for the level of standing water around the circuit. Aquaplaning, where the tyre struggles to break the surface tension of the water on-track, was nonetheless prevalent - but water dispersal as the rain held off soon brought the track to a more driveable state.

The downside of using the extreme wet tyre lies in the greater water dispersal (according to Pirelli, around 85 litres of water per second) which drastically cuts visibility as the spray rooster-tails out the back of the car. Yet, the dispersal is a necessary evil: without it, the circuit would just remain wetter for longer.

Although the rain lights ensure that the driver behind has at least some level of visibility, selecting your braking zone remains tricky; poor visibility means the driver must find a reference point in their immediate circle of vision. Stopping distances are also considerably longer, so a driver needs a different marker to their usual point of pedal application in the dry.

Considering all these climatic challenges, it's small wonder why race control takes a more tentative approach to wet conditions. Hence, it was a welcome surprise to see the session reopened - even if the circuit was still sodden with the afternoon downpour. Carlos Sainz reckoned that it was a "punchy" call from the FIA - but it only took a couple of laps to ensure the cars were more stable.

"It felt a bit punchy when we left on the x-wet because we were aquaplaning in sixth and seventh gear down the straights. And if you lose the car at those speeds, it's always going to be a big one," Sainz concluded after the session.

"Also, very little visibility when you were running close to a car, but we were not forced to run close to cars in quali, so you can create a bit of a buffer to see. But it was very sketchy for two laps.

"Then we managed to create that little bit of dry line and the tyres started working, the aquaplaning started to go away. Everyone managed to keep the car on track until the end of Q1, which was a bit of a surprise, to be honest."

Liam Lawson agreed with Sainz's view of the session, stating that "when we started, it was extremely sketchy - I think we were definitely pushing it. But I like the fact that we were out there and not in the garage; I think obviously it is risky, but there weren't that many incidents."

As expected, the wet conditions delivered chances to those usually not accustomed to fighting at the top; the free practice performance-chasing was effectively rendered obsolete and the power units had slightly more parity as the effects of top-end performance and acceleration were mitigated by the low-grip track conditions.

This put a bit more of a premium on low-speed downforce and, crucially, keeping the tyres warm across Q1 - although Fernando Alonso nonetheless noted that "the engine is very important in terms of drivability and the way it behaves in the corners, and we still have a little bit of an issue there".
The approach through Q1 was, initially, simply about trying to set clean laps and hope that the progression of the circuit and the tyres would yield a lap-on-lap improvement.

Of course, each driver was tested on their reaction times in the event aquaplaning occurred, and the 2026 power units and the control over the rear brakes added another hurdle to overcome. But each driver (largely) became increasingly dialled in, watched as the laptimes improved, and then started to push the braking zones a little bit more as the circuit dried up.

There was a transition point in Q2, however, as the intermediates soon became the tyre to be on. With less standing water, the full wet was starting to overheat and was giving up performance in the middle part of the lap, initially enough to perhaps offset the dampness through the first and final sectors, before all three became much more suitable for the intermediate overall.

This meant that they could chase the track grip more, and it was evident that the times had begun to peak at the end of Q2 as the circuit approached its best conditions under the downpour. Getting the intermediate timing right, which Lawson reckoned he and his Racing Bulls team had nailed, was key to getting a couple of quicker laps in without risking the threat of falling off the circuit.

A few drivers struggled at this crossover, particularly with harvesting and braking into Turn 12 - Sainz and Ollie Bearman both had offs here, as newcomer Rafael Camara couldn't get the car to slow down enough before he careened into the barrier at the close of Q2.

With more rain impending during Q3, it was more about a mad dash to get a clean lap in, rather than watching the progression. That's perhaps when it felt most like 'normal' qualifying, as the tyres were effectively good enough for one lap with the expected downpour setting something of a timer.

It appeared that the majority of the drivers genuinely enjoyed the rare chance to tackle properly wet conditions, although some had a few qualms about the session restarting. George Russell surmised that "I love driving in the rain - but at some point, if that was a race, that was no way we should be driving in it -  the chances of seeing a really, really horrific incident is very, very high."

Perhaps there's a bit of a split of opinion between the younger and older drivers; both Lewis Hamilton and Nico Hulkenberg expressed their enjoyment of wet conditions, while new champion Kimi Antonelli labelled them "the wettest conditions I've ever driven [in]. So it was not the nicest of experiences"; both he and Bearman said that the circuit was over the limit at the Q1 restart, although the latter conceded that the early running did at least contribute to the circuit improving.

Regardless, it was valuable data for each of the drivers ahead of Sunday's race - where inclement weather is expected to play a role once again. And so begins the overnight discussions: does anyone risk a pit-lane start for a set-up change?

items.titleZh: 车手担忧2026规则削弱巴西大奖赛超车观赏性
items.summaryZh: F1车手担心2026年技术规则的特殊性会让英特拉格斯周日下午的比赛失去超车观赏性，汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘都认为从后排追赶的难度将大幅增加。
items.originalTitle: What's got F1 drivers so worried about Brazilian GP spectacle
items.summaryEn: F1 drivers fear the peculiarities of the 2026 regulations will neuter the spectacle at Interlagos on Sunday afternoon, with Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen both feeling their chances of charging through the field are much reduced.
detailZh: 巴西大奖赛见证过许多从F1发车格后排发起的著名追击，因为历史上超车在这里一直很容易。
但F1车手们确实担心，2026年规则的特殊性会让周日下午英特拉格斯的比赛观赏性大打折扣。
就在一周前的墨西哥，刘易斯·汉密尔顿和兰多·诺里斯都抱怨过赛车超过一定速度阈值后能量部署功率下降过快的问题。汉密尔顿称这些“愚蠢”，诺里斯说它们“有点毁掉比赛”。
而2026年规则正是包括汉密尔顿和马克斯·维斯塔潘在内的车手们觉得从后排追赶机会大幅减少的原因，这两位车手都曾在巴西从低发车位起步并取得成功。
汉密尔顿因被罚退10位将从第20位发车，他表示“超车将会非常、非常、非常困难。我不确定你们还能看到过去那种比赛”。
汉密尔顿本人曾在2021年巴西大奖赛从第10位发车夺冠，当时他在冲刺赛中从最后一名追上来，赛车还换装了新引擎；但他觉得，如今每辆车在直道模式下都能减阻，而不像旧DRS规则下那样相互抵消，这意味着2026年的这场比赛很可能更加静态。
维斯塔潘也认同这种对局面的解读，他曾从第17位发车赢得2024年的这场比赛。
“现在我们不再有DRS，而且这里的超车模式因为长直道而非常受限，每个人都在耗尽电池，”他说。
“所以你在直道上的速度差会小很多，有点像墨西哥那样。因此我认为，在长直道上超车会困难得多。”
这个超车模式让任何在一秒时间阈值内跟随另一辆车的车手获得额外0.5兆焦耳的能量，但威廉姆斯车手卡洛斯·塞恩斯估计这只值“十分之一或两秒”，这本身不太可能足以形成鼓励超车的速度差。
“总之，考虑到正在发生的处罚和其他一切，我不指望太往前看，”他说。
但这里的天气是巨大的变数，因为超车模式的局限性只有在干燥条件下才真正相关。
在湿地条件下，主动空气动力学系统也可以被禁用——因此尾流效应会变得更大。
迈凯伦车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉表示，他“如果正赛是干地才会感到惊讶”，这对F1而言将是一次未知领域的探索，考虑到此前在马来西亚举行的巴林大奖赛开赛时赛道几乎已经变干，而在新加坡的雨战则是一场冲刺赛，那条赛道无论规则如何都几乎不可能超车。
“目前天气预报显示会有相当多的降雨，所以如果正赛是干地我会感到惊讶，”斯特拉说道。
“目前还不清楚降雨量有多大、强度会有多高。可能是持续性的降雨，但不会太大。
在某些条件下，能见度问题就在于轮胎和赛车会扬起一定量的水雾，你对此无能为力，只能因为能见度和水滑现象而中止比赛。
我认为如果能见度还算可以接受，那我们就能进行比赛，而且我希望，就像我说的，根据天气预报，即使降雨持续，也应该是较小级别的、较低强度的降雨。
而且我们在排位赛中已经看到，实际上从能见度和轮胎抓地力的角度来看，赛车能够承受一定量的积水。所以我对能够举行比赛持乐观态度。但我对比赛会在干燥条件下进行就没那么乐观了。
从倍耐力的角度来看，雨胎在排位赛中的成功意味着无论条件如何，两款雨胎都是可行的选择。
在干地条件下，由于轮胎退化严重，预计将是一场两停的比赛。
最可能的路线是软胎/中性胎/软胎或中性胎/硬胎/软胎。硬胎只有在温度下降时才会派上用场——这恰好符合其较低的工作温度范围——但一停会比两停慢10秒，因此并不理想。
不过，F1正赛类型的关键在于当地时间下午2点的天气情况，以及预计的早晨阵雨是否已经过去。
如果阵雨还没过去，比赛局面可能会非常开放。
detailEn: The Brazilian Grand Prix has been witness to many famous charges from the lower reaches of the Formula 1 grid because overtaking has historically been easy.
But there are genuine fears among F1 drivers that the peculiarities of the 2026 regulations will neuter the spectacle at Interlagos on Sunday afternoon.

Only one week ago in Mexico, Lewis Hamilton and Lando Norris were both bemoaning the energy deployment ramp-down rates that kick in once F1 cars clear a certain threshold of speed. Hamilton called them "stupid" and Norris said they "kind of ruin racing".

And the 2026 rules are why drivers including Hamilton and Max Verstappen, who have both tasted success in Brazil when starting from lowly grid positions, feel their chances of coming through the field are much reduced.

Hamilton, who will start 20th after picking up a 10-place grid penalty, suggested "overtaking will be very, very, very hard. I'm not sure you're going to see the same sort of races that you've seen in the past".

Hamilton himself won the 2021 Brazilian GP from 10th on the grid, having come from the very back in the sprint race with a new engine fitted, but he feels the fact every car will shed drag in straight mode, rather than being offset like they were racing under the old DRS rules, means the 2026 race is likely to be more static.
This reading of the situation was echoed by Verstappen, who won the 2024 edition of this race from 17th on the grid.
"Now we don't have DRS anymore and the overtake mode is very limiting around here because of the long straight, everyone is draining the battery," he said.
"So your speed difference on the straight is going to be a lot less, a bit like Mexico really. So it will be quite a lot harder, I think, to pass [on] the long straight."

That overtake mode gives any driver following another car within a one-second time threshold an extra 0.5MJ of energy, but Williams driver Carlos Sainz estimated that to be worth only "one or two tenths", which is unlikely to be enough of a pace offset in of itself to encourage overtaking.
"Anyway I'm not expecting to look forward too much with the amount of penalties that are happening and everything," he said.
But the weather is the massive curveball here because the limitations of overtake mode are only really relevant in the dry.
In the wet, active aero can be disabled too - so the slipstream effect becomes bigger.

McLaren team principal Andrea Stella said he "would be surprised if we have a dry race", which would be a venture into the unknown for F1 considering the Bahrain GP in Malaysia had almost dried out by the time it got under way and in Singapore the wet race was a sprint on a track where overtaking is pretty much impossible regardless of the ruleset.
"At the moment in the forecast, there's quite a lot of rain, so I would be surprised if we have a dry race," Stella said.
"It's unclear how much rain, what the intensity is going to be. It could be steady, but not too heavy.

"In some conditions, the visibility is just the fact that the tyres and the cars, they just lift a certain amount of water, and there's nothing you can do, you just have to stop the session because of the visibility and the aquaplaning.

"I think if the visibility can be somehow acceptable, then I think we can have a race, and I hope, like I said, that based on the forecast, even if the rain will be steady, it should be lower class, a lower level of rain.

"And we have seen in qualifying that actually the cars, from a visibility and tyre grip point of view, they can tolerate a certain amount of water. So I'm optimistic that we should be able to have a race. I'm not that optimistic that it will be in dry conditions."
From Pirelli's perspective, the success of the wet rubber in qualifying means that both rain tyres are viable options no matter the conditions.
In the dry, a two-stop race is on the cards because degradation is high.

The most likely route is soft/medium/soft or medium/hard/soft. The hard will only come into play if temperatures drop - which fits perfectly with its lower working range - but a one stop is 10 seconds slower so not ideal.
Key though to the type of race F1 geta will be what the weather does by 2pm local time, and if the expected morning showers have blown through.
If they haven't, there is a chance things will be very wide open.
